code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if not col or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
              seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        objs.append((col,pts))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    mid=h/2
    for col,pts in objs:
      miny=min(y for y,x in pts); maxy=max(y for y,x in pts)
      shift= -miny if (miny+maxy)/2 < mid else (h-1-maxy)
      for y,x in pts: out[y+shift][x]=col
    return out
